name: storm_clouds
description: Storm clouds: banks of crinkled cloud in teal, violet and orchid, the set's lace their crinkled edge, broad soft colour patches drifting through them, lit as a relief, a few stars along the set.
notes: Round one (077): triage group (8)'s clouds, wallhaven-45oz58 the default, tributaries-25.jpg (tributary_clouds) and wallhaven-3z1jkd (crimson_nebula, sparks at 0.6) as palette entries. Nearest mode: molten_flow (a glossy relief in broad lit folds); here the relief is broad and soft (one band, slope only, no seams) and the cloud is texture and colour: stripe grain at density 64 laid bright (masked to the set) and dark (multiplied), a palette layer on a density-2 stripe screened over the ground so colour drifts in broad patches, a de glow at 0.005 as the cloud's body. Reachable by one escape loop: the default draws from the frame's loop alone (the `billows` formulation adds two views' sheets). Lessons from the drafts: a uniform bloom (de falloff 0.02) is undone by the tone pass, which carries the frame back to the reference's median; a `light` cut into 14 bands draws terraced ledges whose seams read as rings in the far field (the `ledges` formulation); `tia` drew arcs, not plumes. Seats are a --min-ink 0.15 gallery scout (seed 77), maxiter under 15,000, spirals and degree 6 passed over; most of the forty still whirl at draft size and were dropped by eye, and two phoenix-classic seats at about 14,000 iterations with a sixth of the frame interior took ~200 s a draft at six threads (every loop iterates the interior to maxiter), so were dropped on cost. The default stack drew at a deep multibrot seat as lace with seams, not cloud: what reads as cloud is a shallow seat where the colour banks and grain have room (the phoenix-classic seat at 1,071 iterations). Explorer cost (080, `style cost`, read beside other Node workers: an upper bound): 154 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at its deepest kept seat (julia-multibrot3_f36300cb, maxiter 7,951), under the 5-minute bar. Entry blue_nebula (item 092's baseline tile, kept 2026-11-26; wallhaven-jewqgw, a blue nebula with red filaments): the stack as it is in that reference's map, kept at 092's seat phoenix_6046d762, unscored.
